sights.address: 45 Truong Dinh, Ben Thanh Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
sights.w: Saigon's only Hindu temple, a vivid South-Indian shrine built by Tamil merchants in the late 1800s to the goddess Mariamman, its ~12 m gopuram crowded with painted deities. Free; daily ~07:00-19:00, remove shoes.

sights.n: Ho Thi Ky Flower & Food Market
sights.address: Ho Thi Ky Street (Alley 52), Ward 1, District 10, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
sights.w: A 24-hour wholesale flower market (blooms trucked in nightly from Da Lat) wrapped in a warren of alleys that turn into one of Saigon's best night food streets, heavy with Khmer-Vietnamese 'Little Cambodia' dishes. Liveliest in the evening.

sights.address: Truong Dinh Street, Ben Thanh Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
sights.w: One of central Saigon's largest green spaces (a former French garden), with a Cham-style shrine, a Hung Kings temple and a famous early-morning 'bird cafe' where locals hang songbird cages (~06:00-09:00; disrupted in recent years by Metro works). Free.

sights.address: 1 Ton That Tung (corner Nguyen Trai), Nguyen Cu Trinh Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
sights.w: A serene 1902-05 Gothic Catholic church funded by Le Phat Dat (Huyen Sy), once the richest man in the south and great-grandfather of Vietnam's last queen, with a granite-and-stained-glass nave and the founders' tombs behind the chancel. Free.

sights.address: 81 Nguyen Xien, Long Binh Ward, Thu Duc City, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
sights.w: A gleaming white Thai/Indian-style Theravada temple and 56 m Gotama Cetiya stupa on a hill above the Dong Nai River in Thu Duc, named by National Geographic (2019) among the world's 10 most beautiful Buddhist sites. Free; incense-free grounds.

sights.address: 1147 Binh Quoi, Ward 28 (Thanh Da Peninsula), Binh Thanh District, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
sights.w: A riverside 'traditional-village' recreation park on the Thanh Da peninsula run by Saigontourist, known for its weekend Southern-style buffets, folk games and thatched-hut gardens along the Saigon River. Free entry; paid activities and buffet.

sights.address: 66 Dong Du, Ben Nghe Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
sights.w: A calm blue-and-white 1935 mosque built by South-Indian Muslim traders on a busy District 1 street, the largest in the city and a quiet oasis behind the Dong Du shops. Open daily; dress modestly, busiest at Friday midday.

sights.address: 336 Hai Ba Trung (corner Nguyen Huu Cau), Tan Dinh Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
sights.w: A striking 1926-27 French market hall with a butter-yellow facade and three towers, now the city's best-known fabric market (ao dai silks) ringed by a wet-market and street-food stalls. Daily ~05:00-18:00.

sights.n: Le Van Duyet Tomb (Lang Ong Ba Chieu)
sights.address: 1 Vu Tung, Ward 1 (Ba Chieu), Binh Thanh District, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
sights.w: The walled tomb-temple of Marshal Le Van Duyet (1763-1832), the eunuch viceroy of Gia Dinh, one of the city's oldest and most revered shrines and a recognised national relic; thronged during the Ky Yen festival. Free, beside Ba Chieu Market.

sights.n: Saigon Zoo & Botanical Gardens (Thao Cam Vien)
sights.address: 2 Nguyen Binh Khiem, Ben Nghe Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
sights.w: Founded 1864-65, one of the world's eight oldest continuously operating zoos: a 20 ha park of century-old trees, colonial-era buildings and the Hung Kings temple alongside the animal enclosures. Daily; ticketed.

sights.n: Quan Am Pagoda (On Lang Assembly Hall)
sights.address: 12 Lao Tu, Ward 11, District 5, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
sights.w: A 1740 Fujianese temple in Cholon dedicated to Guanyin, one of the district's oldest and most ornate, with elaborate ceramic roof friezes, shard-mosaic reliefs and gilded carvings. Free, ~06:00-18:00.

sights.address: Thu Thiem Ward, Thu Duc City (District 2), Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
sights.w: A 20 ha riverfront park opened December 2023 on the Thu Thiem side, with a ~3.7 km promenade, lawns and cycling paths facing the District 1 skyline; the classic spot for sunset and floodlit night skyline views. Open 24h, free.

sights.address: 41 Hoang Du Khuong, Ward 12, District 10, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
sights.w: A private museum (opened 2007) in a reconstructed traditional wooden house of ~18 rooms, with 3,000+ artifacts of Vietnamese herbal medicine, an old apothecary shop and pressing and decoction tools. Daily ~08:30-17:00; ticketed.
